title: Friedrich Nietzsche's birth chart
metaDescription: Friedrich Nietzsche's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 22.2° Libra. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: 0.7° separates Mercury and Uranus from an exact opposition; at that range thinking and disruption read as one mechanism. Oppositions are read as full-moon geometry — maximum visibility between two needs that share one spine.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: The Sun's position resolves to 22.2° Libra — deep enough in the third decan (20°–30°) that Mercury, its traditional sub-ruler, colours the reading.

blocks.title: The fast planets
blocks.text: For the fast movers, Mercury was at 4.3° Libra, Venus was at 6.5° Virgo, Mars was at 28.0° Virgo. Read together: thought that travels by comparison; attraction that grows by reliability; effort banked steadily until it tells.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Nothing in the geometry sits closer than Mercury and Uranus: 0.7° from an exact opposition. The scheme reads an opposition as an axis to walk, not a fight to win: the chart keeps both ends lit. Behind it, the Sun opposition Pluto at 0.8°, and the Sun trine Neptune at 1.2° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. All of it stands whatever the hour was: each angle was tested from midnight to midnight before it was written down.

blocks.title: The standing structure
blocks.text: The Moon makes no major aspect that survives the day; the old reading gives such a planet autonomy — it acts alone, sometimes loudly.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The dignity table, which predates the outer planets and only ever spoke for seven, marks four placements here. The Sun in Libra at 22.2° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given; Venus in Virgo at 6.5° is in fall; Jupiter in Pisces at 26.0° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; Saturn in Aquarius at 0.8° is in domicile. None of this ranks anyone; dignity describes footing, and footing can be worked with.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: The certain ground: 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day, dividing 4 air, 3 fire, 2 earth, 1 water by element and 4 cardinal, 4 mutable, 2 fixed by mode. Jupiter, Uranus, Neptune and Pluto were retrograde — the optical reversal the tradition reads as review — energy turned over before it is turned out.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Sagittarius for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 14.6° between midnight and midnight. Whatever the unrecorded hour was, it happened inside one Moon sign — the degree floats, the sign holds. At the noon reference it stands at 10.3°.
